Shared host without exclusivity. Four matched repetitions are development evidence, not a precision performance budget.

Light recording-on/off controls share identical callback sampling and publication observers; recording is their only deliberate instrumentation difference.
Raw logs remain in the build evidence directory and campaign records their hashes; complete parsed original reports and invocation/input/runtime custody are retained here.
